description: A player at 0 or less life loses the game as a state-based action, and in a two-player game the remaining player wins immediately - basic game-end recognition that no existing gold state exercises.
artificial_state_elements: Combat damage bringing seat 2 to 0 life is an arbitrary trigger for the state-based check - any life-loss-to-0-or-below event works identically.
Creature power/toughness and board state beyond the life totals are not material.
material_characteristics: A player with 0 or less life loses the game as a state-based action (CR 704.5a), checked before either player would receive priority again
In a two-player game, one player losing ends the game with the other as winner (CR 104.2a, CR 104.3a)
abstracted_characteristics: The specific source of the life loss - any combat damage, effect, or ability bringing life to 0 or below is equivalent for this check
All board state not directly involved in the life-total check

illegal_actions_to_reject: Continuing to offer seat 2 priority, casting spells, or taking any further game actions after the state-based action check - the game must end before priority is passed again
expected.outcome_if_resolved: State-based action check: seat 2 has 0 life and loses the game (CR 704.5a); seat 1 is the sole remaining player and wins (CR 104.2a).
